## Parameter Writable By Everybody

Operators need to adjust the parameter P1 manually quite often. Changing it does not pose any risk, so it can be written directly to the PLC.

## Writable By Admins Only

The parameter P3 controls a crucial part of this machine and is restricted to users who are members of the **Administrators** group.

# »Inputs allow operators to edit, or enter data, thereby changing the state of your PLC.«

A Numeric Stepper, Text Field, and Switch are all Inputs in HELIO. There's also the **Magic Input**, which adapts to the data type for an optimal user interface. For instance, numbers turn it into a Numeric Stepper, booleans into a Switch.

# »Outputs display data without the ability to edit it.«

There are many ways to show your data, like Gauges, Pie Charts, or Radial Bars. But if you want something simple, you can use the Magic Output. It also changes into different formats depending on the type of data you connect to it.

## Parameter Writable By Signed In Users

Operators frequently need to manually adjust the parameter P2. This change does not carry any risk, so it can be directly written to the PLC. However, it is still necessary to be signed in order to make the adjustment.

Not only the HMI, but also your PLC can provide **Translation Keys** that will be translated by HELIO automatically.  For example message titles and descriptions can be provided by the PLC as a specific HMI Data Type: **Translation Keys**.

# Examples

In this Markdown Element we've linked an HMI Data Variable with the **Translation Key** type. If you connect a PLC, and provide an existing Translation Key, e.g.  *com.helio-hmi.builtin.translation.Example* the value will be translated. Here we go…

**»During the Execute state, the machine carries out its primary tasks.«**

In this state, the machine operates and carries out its designed operations, such as packaging or processing. 

This state is important because it reflects the machine's actual operation and is a major indicator of its working status. 

It is the stage where you can effectively **measure the machine's productivity and efficiency**, **offering useful information** about its performance.
Data sources can provide durations as strings in the standardized **ISO 8601 format**. For instance, the string **PT8H30M** represents *8 hours* and *30 minutes*.

# Multilingual? Definitely!

HELIO assists you in localizing your HMIs, with multi-language support included by default.

- Feel free to add as many languages as you want to your projects.
- Use the Dynamic Property **Localizable Text** for labels in your HMI. These texts will automatically be added to your Translations in the Translation Manager.
- Export and import those translations as CSV files.
- You can also add custom translations there with custom Translation Keys.
- Finally your PLC can provide these **Translation Keys** as HMI Variables, which HELIO will translate without further action required.

This machine has the capability to rotate both clockwise and counterclockwise.

The advantage of **clockwise** rotation is that it optimizes the machine's efficiency and prolongs its lifespan. It is therefore the default way to handle things.

Meanwhile, **counterclockwise** rotation can be helpful in certain situations, as it may provide a more thorough processing of materials in certain applications.

# Support on the Way to Becoming an Expert

Creating effective HMIs is not just about adding numerous features. Providing appropriate resources to help your customers to get the most out of your products is equally important. 

The web-based foundation of HELIO enables us to incorporate a variety of content that can guide your customers from beginners to experts and enthusiasts.

# Value Bar

A **Value Bar** simplifies the interpretation of numerical values by displaying the current value, its range, and highlighting good, alarming, or critical areas within the range.

The **Open Page as Overlay** action lets you open a floating overlay right above the page you're on. Inside this overlay, you can show off any page from your current project. And guess what? This works because HELIO Pages are naturally responsive.
